warnings.message: Codex skips a new or changed user hook until it is reviewed and trusted (/hooks; trust is recorded against the hook's hash): trust the harness forbid guard once on this machine, or flags-anywhere forbids hold only in their prefix form until then
Codex has no "edits free, commands ask" mode: auto-edit compiles like ask (approval_policy on-request)
ask write deploy/** dropped on codex: Codex has no ask for writes or tools

allow command ["pnpm"] not emitted on codex: an execpolicy allow runs outside the sandbox, and an interpreter runs any script there (deny_read and egress hold only inside it); the command runs sandboxed instead

allow command ["node"] not emitted on codex: an execpolicy allow runs outside the sandbox, and an interpreter runs any script there (deny_read and egress hold only inside it); the command runs sandboxed instead

allow ["git", ["status", "log", "diff", "show", "branch", "add", "commit", "fetch", "pull", "push", "switch", "checkout", "worktree"]], ["gh", "pr", ["create", "view", "ready", "comment"]] not emitted on codex: an execpolicy allow runs outside the sandbox, past deny_read and egress; the commands run sandboxed instead (accept_gaps {engine: codex, field: allow, profiles: [workstation]} emits them)

accepted.message: write **/.git/hooks/**: a filesystem "read" downgrade covers sandboxed commands, not the apply_patch tool
accepted.reason: the .git/hooks write deny downgrades sandboxed commands only; the product's walls (L2 hook deny) refuse apply_patch there

accepted.message: fail_if_unavailable has no documented Codex key
accepted.reason: the launcher refuses to start Codex where its sandbox is unavailable

notes: roles compile for the unattended tier only: a auto-edit session has no allowlist boundary for a role to narrow
